name: Incredible CheeseCake Factory
notes: Restaurant's own WooCommerce shop (address 3161 Adams Avenue confirmed in the site footer). curl gets a hard 403 — a real host-level block, and r.jina.ai returns a Cloudflare challenge too — so this was read through the browser pane via the shop's own public wc/store/v1 REST API. EVERY size of every product was fetched individually (173 variations across 29 variable products, plus 11 fixed-price items); no price is inferred and no size ladder was extrapolated. That matters here: the flavors do NOT all sell the same sizes — 14 offer the full seven, 9 offer only five (no Junior 6" and no Hostess 8"), 3 offer six, and Chocolate Pistachio Kataifi and Sugar Free Plain have their own price ladders entirely. An earlier pass applied one verified ladder to all of them and produced 21 rows for sizes those flavors are not sold in; this replaces it. This is a bakery rather than a restaurant, so every row is a purchasable SKU rather than a plated dish. Rebuilt by the coordinator session 2026-08-31.

name: Baba Kabob Poway
notes: This brand has two San Diego-area locations (Miramar and Poway) with their own Square Online storefronts linked separately from the shared babakabobsd.com site, which itself states 'Prices may vary by location' -- confirmed by comparing: the shared site's generic /menu page lists e.g. Gyro Sandwich $13.99 and Hummus and Pita $9.99, while the Poway-specific Square site lists the same base prices but with different upper-range add-on pricing, so the Poway Square Online storefront (babakabobpoway.square.site) was used as the location-correct source rather than the shared generic page, matching this batch's address (13538 Poway Road). Square Online lazy-loads its category sections on scroll; had to trigger that (End key) to get Sandwiches/Sides/Kids Meal/Salads/Family Platters/Drinks beyond the initially-rendered Entrees/Deserts/Starters. Most entrees, sandwiches, salads, starters and family platters are shown with a PRICE RANGE (e.g. Beef Kabob $18.99-$27.98) reflecting size/extra-meat/combo add-ons chosen at order time; recorded the base (minimum) price in each case and noted the top of the range in the description rather than averaging or picking a price in between. 'House Salad' is listed identically under both 'Sides' and 'Salads' on the source site itself and is kept in both sections as published. 44 items across Entrees, Deserts, Starters, Sandwiches, Sides, Kids Meal, Salads, Family Platters, Drinks.
